get.description: automation.read + status.read + records.read + scheduling.read. Batch current user identities, latest effective specialized binding summaries, actual active binding count and next enabled queue schedule. No query, configuration compilation or full DryRun.

200.description: catalogRevision, progressRevision, observedAt and items. Each item contains userId, summaryReason (no_bindings/not_run/record_deleted/no_task_report/latest), summaryTone (bad/warn/muted/ok), nullable runId, activeCount, nullable nextRunAt/queueId, and the contributing binding summaries. Missing permission is not a not_run result.
